stories.label: Iran crisis — Feb 26 talks days away as student protests continue
stories.summary: Feb 26 Geneva talks days away. Student protests ongoing. US evacuated Beirut staff. Joint Chiefs chairman warned of risks, Trump denied it. Iran says any attack including limited strikes is 'act of aggression.' Not selected — 21 articles deep, only cover for talks outcome, military action, or deal framework.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — 25 soldiers killed in retaliation after El Mencho raid
stories.summary: Major escalation: 25 National Guard troops killed across 6 separate retaliatory attacks. Roadblocks in 20 states. Class divide visible — tourists watching from luxury pools as neighborhoods burn. Sheinbaum says calm being restored.

stories.label: Israel advances death penalty bill targeting Palestinians
stories.summary: Knesset debating death penalty bill. First execution since Eichmann (1962) would be Palestinian. Not selected this cycle but still developing.

stories.label: Hong Kong 47: All appeals dismissed in largest NSL trial
stories.summary: All 12 appeals dismissed. Legal architecture for permanent political control established.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — 4th anniversary passed
stories.summary: 4th anniversary passed. Zelensky accuses Putin of starting WWIII. Slovakia halts emergency power to Ukraine over Russian oil dispute with Hungary. No concrete new development beyond expected rhetoric.

stories.label: Israeli forces detain 100+ Palestinians in Ramadan
stories.summary: 100+ detained since Ramadan began. Al-Aqsa access blocked. West Bank mosque torched by settlers. 9,300 currently held.

stories.label: 200+ Venezuelan political prisoners on hunger strike
stories.summary: 200+ political prisoners on hunger strike. Amnesty law excludes military-charge detainees. Venezuela now demanding Maduro's release from US custody.

stories.label: Netherlands installs youngest PM Jetten
stories.summary: Rob Jetten becomes youngest Dutch PM. Minority government installed after Wilders coalition collapse.

stories.label: Zambian communities poisoned by Copperbelt mining boom
stories.summary: Green transition mining boom causing pollution in Copperbelt. Classic extraction pattern with new commodity.

stories.label: Pakistan warns 7.1M at risk from melting glaciers
stories.summary: Temperatures 3-5°C above normal. 13,000 glaciers, 10,000 receding. 7.1M people vulnerable to glacial floods.

stories.label: Nobel laureate's water-from-air invention
stories.summary: Metal-organic frameworks extract clean water from air — up to 1,000 litres/day.

stories.label: Bitcoin miner dumps treasury for AI data center pivot
stories.summary: Bitdeer sold entire bitcoin treasury for AI data center expansion.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — EU freezes trade deal, contradictory policies
stories.summary: CBP to stop collecting struck-down tariffs Feb 24. Trump threatening 'much higher' tariffs and new licenses. EU Parliament froze trade deal. Three contradictory US positions simultaneously active. Markets mixed on signals.

stories.label: Sudan war — Chad border closed, humanitarian crisis deepening
stories.summary: Chad border still closed. Museveni's son compared RSF to Hitler days after his father hosted Dagalo. Bellingcat investigation on child soldiers recruited via TikTok. Not selected this cycle — needs dedicated internal humanitarian angle when fresh data emerges.

stories.label: Israel designates 5 Palestinian news outlets as terrorist groups
stories.summary: 5 Palestinian news orgs designated terrorist groups. Criminalizes consuming, sharing, or working for outlets. Enforcement actions in occupied East Jerusalem already reported.

stories.label: ICC opens confirmation hearing against Duterte for drug war killings
stories.summary: ICC prosecutors say Duterte personally authorized murders as crimes against humanity. First SE Asian head of state at ICC. Drug war killed 12,000-30,000.

stories.label: AI tools can now design entire genomes from scratch
stories.summary: AI systems architecting whole organisms. Biosecurity governance gap widening as capability outpaces regulation.

stories.label: Meta AI Safety Director's agent deletes her inbox
stories.summary: Meta alignment director's inbox deleted by AI agent she was testing. Called it 'rookie mistake.' Illustrates agent safety problem.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria base, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month per Al Monitor. Turkey repatriating ISIS fighters from Iraq as jihadis escalate Syria attacks. Kurdish SDF losing last external backer.

stories.label: China's Type 095 nuclear attack submarine confirmed
stories.summary: First satellite confirmation of China's next-gen Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine.

stories.label: Ghana takes slavery case to UN with AU backing
stories.summary: President Mahama with AU endorsement pushing UN recognition of transatlantic slavery.

stories.label: Marshall Islands first national UBI via crypto
stories.summary: First national UBI via cryptocurrency and Starlink.

stories.label: China builds Africa's space infrastructure
stories.summary: Satellite ground stations, orbital labs, continent-wide Chinese-funded space network.

stories.label: Pakistan strikes inside Afghanistan — UN confirms civilian deaths
stories.summary: UN confirms at least 13 civilians killed in Pakistan strikes in Afghanistan. Taliban vows retaliation. Pakistan says 'cannot tolerate anymore.'

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison's port concession unconstitutional. Government ordered occupation of Balboa and Cristobal terminals for 'urgent social interest.' Panama's own courts drove this, not Trump, but it lands amid US pressure over Chinese presence at the canal.

stories.label: France restricts US Ambassador Kushner after he ignores summons
stories.summary: France stripped Ambassador Charles Kushner of direct access to ministers after he ignored a formal summons over Trump admin comments on a far-right killing. NATO ally downgrading a US ambassador is extraordinary.

stories.label: Binance fired employees who found $1.7B sent to Iran
stories.summary: NYT reports compliance employees at Binance discovered $1.7B in crypto routed to Iran and were fired. Binance already paid $4.3B fine in 2023. Timing critical as US considers Iran strikes and sanctions are supposed to be the alternative to war.

stories.label: Billion years missing from Earth's history — Great Unconformity solved
stories.summary: New Columbia research resolves 150-year geological mystery. A billion years of rock erased by shifting continents, not snowball Earths. Visible in the Grand Canyon where old rock meets much younger rock with nothing in between.

stories.label: ASML EUV breakthrough could yield 50% more chips by 2030
stories.summary: ASML unveils new EUV light source technology. 50% more chips from same equipment by 2030. In an industry where new fabs cost $20B+, efficiency at the monopoly manufacturer cascades globally. Widens gap between nations with access and those without.

stories.label: African gig workers unknowingly trained US military AI
stories.summary: Rest of World investigation. Data labelers for Appen in Africa had no idea their work was used by the US military. AI supply chain designed to separate workers from end users. Military contracts laundered through layers of subcontracting.

stories.label: First documented victim of AI agent harassment
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI targeting an individual.

stories.label: Nigeria northwest mass killings continue
stories.summary: Pattern of northwest violence continuing. 12 more killed in fresh Plateau attacks. US official visiting re: terrorism financing.

stories.label: Magnitude 7+ earthquake strikes Borneo
stories.summary: M7+ earthquake off northern Borneo. Strongest in Sabah in 11 years. No tsunami.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse
stories.summary: Israeli strikes continue. Lebanon introduced regressive tax hikes drawing public anger. US evacuating Beirut staff.

stories.label: Indonesia bilateral trade deal with Trump
stories.summary: Indonesia secures bilateral deal amid 15% tariff.

stories.label: IS declares new campaign against Syria's post-Assad government
stories.summary: IS campaign against Sharaa's government. Gains urgency with US NE Syria withdrawal and Turkey repatriating ISIS fighters from Iraq.
